title: Decision-Permission Link
claim: Better decision-making and legitimate permission are separate problems; the bridge is a receiver-owned proof obligation bound to the exact proposed effect, current state, policy, and independently verified evidence.
invariants: optimizer advisory output cannot satisfy a permission requirement
requirements bind to the exact effect hash
state drift invalidates the old proposal
policy drift invalidates the old obligation
substitution, self-authorization, and unauthorized routes deny
Verified Commit remains the single-use exact-action effect boundary
falsifiers: changing only optimizer score/rationale changes permission under an unchanged effect and evidence set
a proposal can satisfy its own independent evidence requirement
mutating action settings after obligation compilation preserves eligibility
state or policy drift preserves the old eligibility
COMMIT_ELIGIBLE can execute without Verified Commit
